raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The silver_transactions filter `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR`, added 2026-01-17 under DE-412, drops legitimate late-arriving POSTED transactions. Batches routinely deliver events 1-3 days after txn_ts, and raw has no duplicate txn_ids, so there is nothing stale to remove. That explains the 70-100 rows lost per batch. Removing the filter restores all POSTED rows.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.68,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
